text: Alternatively, a positive energy balance alone is a potent stimulator of anabolism, even in the absence of resistance exercise training, provided that the intake of dietary protein is adequate (27). The amount of lean tissue gains associated with a combined energy surplus and resistance varies with training status. Rozenek and colleagues (1 19) reported that untrained subjects gained approximately 3 kg (6.6 lb) in 8 weeks when resistance training was combined with an energy surplus of approximately 2,000 kcal/ day; a control group consuming a eucaloric diet did not significantly increase body mass.
